details.inspection: Not known, to be scheduled by on-site authority
details.hazeUse: Haze provided and operated by event production

show.effectsText: The show will be lissajous sheets of light, varying in colour and concentration. There will be NO straight beams used on site; these are disabled digitally within the control software. Pangolin Beyond will be used as primary control on a Lenovo laptop, and in the rare event of failure a backup control PC will be on site with a duplicate of the showfile. The desired effect is to create a ceiling of lissajous effects a minimum of 3 m above the height of the crowd, terminating into open sky in line with established festival laser advisory practice.
show.unitsControlText: The units being used are custom-built 5 W and 10 W RGB projectors. The diodes are tuned to 445, 532 and 640 nm (RGB) respectively; beam size at aperture is 2.6 mm with a divergence of 0.9 mrad. They will be controlled via Pangolin Beyond using FB3 + ILDA control runs. Output is constrained by software zoning verified at alignment, plus physical steel shuttering and blackened aluminium masking fixed at each aperture.
show.firstAidLocation: Event medical centre, location confirmed at site induction
show.showStopChannel: Event control via radio; direct line to stage manager
